ticket: Add a due date field to the item creation form in the frontend so a user can pick a date when creating an item. Keep the existing fields working.
Let a user choose a label color for an item in the item creation form. Store it with the form values.
Add an attachment field to the item creation form where the user can drop or select a single file. The file does not need to be uploaded yet; just hold it in the form state and show its name.
Split the user sign-up form into two steps: account details first (email, password), then profile (full name), with a next and back button.
Add a 1 to 5 star rating control to the item creation form. The chosen rating should be part of the submitted form values.
Add a keyboard-triggered command palette (Ctrl+K or Cmd+K) that lets a logged-in user jump to Dashboard, Items and Settings.
Add archive and unarchive endpoints for items in the backend API. An archived item should not appear in the default item list.
Add an optional search query parameter to the list items endpoint in the backend that filters items by title, case-insensitive.
Add a backend endpoint that exports the current user's items as a CSV file download.
Add a backend endpoint that deletes several items at once given a list of ids. A user may only delete their own items.
Add a backend endpoint that duplicates an item: creates a copy of the given item owned by the current user and returns the copy.
Add a backend endpoint that returns how many items the current user owns.
